metadata.name: axel_v2
metadata.description: AXEL v2: tokenized taxi cars with escrowed raises and exact revenue accounting

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step of the admin handover, signed by the proposed admin.

instructions.name: activate_project
docs: Pays a funded raise out to the treasury and the operator and starts operation.
Admin only, before the activation deadline.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays for missing destination accounts and receives the escrow's rent.

instructions.name: buy_shares
docs: Buys shares in an open raise; payment goes to the escrow. Moves the project to
Funded when the last share is sold.

accounts.name: owner_share_account
docs: The owner's canonical share account. Anyone can create it in advance, and it is then
frozen by default; the purchase thaws it either way.

instructions.name: cancel_raise
docs: Fails a raise that has not been activated, opening refunds. Admin only.

instructions.name: cancel_recovery
docs: Withdraws a pending recovery: the affected owner can veto it until its eta, the admin
can withdraw it until it is executed.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or the request's `from_owner`.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pays a position's unclaimed revenue to the owner's canonical payment account.
Anyone may trigger it for any owner.

accounts.name: claimer
docs: Pays for the owner's payment account if it does not exist.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Closes an empty position and its share account, returning the rent to the owner.
Once the project is closed it also burns the shares left in the position.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Receives the rent of both accounts.

accounts.name: owner_share_account
docs: Wallets let owners close empty token accounts on their own; such an account is
recreated here and closed again, so the position can always be closed.

instructions.name: close_project
docs: Closes an operating or paused project for good without moving any funds; revenue
stays claimable. Admin only.

instructions.name: create_project
docs: Creates a share mint, its transfer hook accounts, the project and its escrow and
revenue vaults, and opens the raise. Admin only.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: A fresh keypair; the share mint is created at this address.

instructions.name: deposit_revenue
docs: The operator pays in one period's revenue, co-signed by the project's oracle as
attestor. The platform fee goes to the treasury, the rest to the holders pro rata.

accounts.name: operator
docs: Supplies the revenue and pays for the period record.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Must equal `project.oracle`.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Transfer hook of the share mints, invoked by Token-2022 on every share transfer.
Settles revenue for both owners, moves the shares in their positions and rejects
the transfer unless both owners are eligible and the project is operating.

accounts.name: authority
docs: owners instead, so a delegate cannot move shares of an owner who lost KYC.

accounts.name: source_investor
docs: record fails as `SourceNotAllowed`.

accounts.name: source_position
docs: `destination_position` and Anchor does not reject duplicate mutable accounts.

instructions.name: execute_recovery
docs: Carries out a recovery after its delay: burns the shares of the old wallet, mints as
many to the new one and moves the unclaimed revenue with them. Anyone may call it.

accounts.name: executor
docs: Pays for the position and share account of `to_owner` if they do not exist.

accounts.name: to_share_account
docs: The canonical share account of `to_owner`; it is thawed here if someone created it
frozen, so only an owner's canonical account ever holds shares.

instructions.name: finalize_raise
docs: Settles a raise whose outcome is certain: Funded or Failed. Anyone may call it.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the global config. Only the program's upgrade authority may call it.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Opens the owner's position and thaws its share account so it can receive shares.
Anyone may pay; the owner needs an eligible KYC record but does not sign.

instructions.name: pause_project
docs: Pauses an operating project: no transfers or deposits, claims keep working. Admin only.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: First step of the admin handover. The default key withdraws a pending proposal.

instructions.name: propose_recovery
docs: Proposes moving `shares` of `from_owner`, a holder who lost its key, to its new wallet
`to_owner` once `config.recovery_delay` has passed. Admin only.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays the request's rent, which returns to it when the request is executed or cancelled.

instructions.name: record_telemetry
docs: Appends up to 20 daily records to the project's telemetry hash chain. Oracle only.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Burns the owner's shares of a failed raise and returns what they cost.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Pays for its payment account if it does not exist.

instructions.name: resume_project
docs: Resumes a paused project. Admin only.

instructions.name: set_investor
docs: Creates or updates the KYC record of `wallet`. Signed by the KYC authority, or by the
demo KYC authority for DEMO records that expire within 30 days.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `config.kyc_authority` or `config.demo_kyc_authority`; pays for a new record.

instructions.name: set_project_roles
docs: Replaces the operator or the oracle of an operating or paused project. Admin only.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Updates fees, windows, payment mints, pause flag and KYC keys. Admin only.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Default when the proposal was withdrawn.

fields.name: claimer
docs: Signer that triggered the claim; payouts always go to the owner.

types.name: Config
docs: Global protocol settings, PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed admin for the two-step handover; default when none is pending.

fields.name: kyc_authority
docs: Production KYC signer (backend, Sumsub).

fields.name: demo_kyc_authority
docs: Demo KYC signer with a restricted scope; default disables it.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the payment-mint token accounts that receive platform fees.

fields.name: allowed_payment_mints
docs: Stablecoins a project may use for payments; unused slots are default.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks buys, transfers, deposits, activation and recoveries. Never blocks claims,
refunds or an owner's veto of a recovery.

fields.name: recovery_delay
docs: Seconds between proposing and executing a share recovery, during which the affected
owner can veto it. A proposal keeps the delay it was made with.

fields.name: price_per_share
docs: Price of one share in base units of the payment mint. Immutable.

fields.name: soft_cap_shares
docs: Minimum shares sold by the deadline for the raise to succeed.

fields.name: activation_window
docs: Seconds the admin has to activate once the raise is funded.

fields.name: additional_metadata
docs: Car attributes shown by wallets and explorers, e.g. make, model, year, city.

fields.name: gross
docs: Revenue for holders before the platform fee, in base units of the payment mint.

fields.name: period_start
docs: First day the deposit covers, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: period_end
docs: Last day the deposit covers, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: report_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the period's P&L report, published off-chain.

fields.name: demo_kyc_authority
docs: Default disables the demo KYC flow.

fields.name: recovery_delay
docs: Owner veto window of share recoveries in seconds; mainnet needs at least 72 hours.

types.name: Investor
docs: KYC record of one wallet, PDA `["investor", wallet]`. `wallet` sits at offset 8.

fields.name: flags
docs: Bit set of `Investor::FLAG_*`.

fields.name: jurisdiction
docs: ISO 3166-1 numeric country code (398 = Kazakhstan), 0 when not disclosed.

fields.name: authority
docs: KYC key that signed the update.

types.name: Position
docs: Share ledger of one owner in one project, PDA `["position", project, owner]`.
`project` sits at offset 8 and `owner` at offset 40 for memcmp filters.

fields.name: shares
docs: Always equal to the owner's share token balance.

fields.name: acc_checkpoint
docs: Accumulator value up to which revenue is already in `accrued`, Q64.64.

fields.name: accrued
docs: Settled revenue not yet claimed.

fields.name: paid_in
docs: Payment tokens paid for shares bought in the raise.

fields.name: shares_burned
docs: Shares burned because the project had closed; zero otherwise.

types.name: Project
docs: One tokenized car, PDA `["project", share_mint]`. `share_mint` sits at offset 8.

fields.name: operator
docs: Fleet operator: receives the raise on activation and deposits revenue.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Fleet reporting system: signs telemetry records and attests revenue deposits.

fields.name: escrow_vault
docs: PDA token account `["escrow", project]` holding the raise until activation or refund.

fields.name: revenue_vault
docs: PDA token account `["revenue", project]` holding deposited revenue until claimed.

fields.name: flags
docs: Bit set of `Project::FLAG_*`.

fields.name: activation_window
docs: Seconds the admin has to activate once the raise is funded.

fields.name: raise_fee_bps
docs: Fees are snapshotted at creation; later config changes never touch a live project.

fields.name: acc_per_share
docs: Revenue per share, Q64.64.

fields.name: total_fees
docs: Platform fees sent to the treasury (raise and revenue).

fields.name: telemetry_head
docs: Hash chain head: `sha256(head || date_le || data_hash)`.

fields.name: last_telemetry_date
docs: Date of the last telemetry record as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: shares_retired
docs: Shares burned by `close_position` after the project closed.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Revenue deposited for holders and not yet claimed; it stays claimable.

fields.name: outcome
docs: `Funded` or `Failed`.

fields.name: cancelled_by
docs: The admin, or `from_owner` exercising its veto.

fields.name: accrued_moved
docs: Unclaimed revenue that moved along with the shares.

fields.name: eta
docs: Earliest execution time; the affected owner can veto until then.

types.name: RecoveryRequest
docs: A pending move of a wallet's shares to another wallet of the same holder, for a lost key
or an inheritance, PDA `["recovery", project, from_owner]`. `project` sits at offset 8
and `from_owner` at offset 40. One request per wallet and project can be pending.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain case file: the holder's request and identity evidence.

fields.name: proposer
docs: Admin that proposed the request and paid its rent, which goes back to it.

fields.name: eta
docs: Earliest execution time; `from_owner` can veto until then.

types.name: RevenuePeriod
docs: One revenue deposit, PDA `["period", project, index as u32 LE]`. `project` sits at offset 8.

fields.name: period_start
docs: Period dates as YYYYMMDD, declared by the operator.

fields.name: supply
docs: Shares outstanding when the deposit was distributed.

fields.name: report_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the period's P&L report, published off-chain.

fields.name: attestor
docs: Oracle key that co-signed the deposit, attesting the report.

fields.name: telemetry_head
docs: Project telemetry chain head at the time of the deposit.

fields.name: deposited_at
docs: Actual deposit time, so backfilled periods stay visible.

types.name: TelemetryEntry
docs: One day of a car's operation. The full report is published off-chain; `data_hash`
commits to it, and the other fields are a summary for explorers and indexers.

fields.name: date
docs: Day of the report as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: data_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the day's canonical (RFC 8785) JSON report.

fields.name: rent_paid
docs: Rent the park charged for the car that day, in whole units of the local currency.

fields.name: status
docs: Vehicle status code of the day, as defined by the published report schema.

types.name: UpdateConfigParams
docs: Every field is optional; `None` keeps the current value.

constants.name: MAX_ACTIVATION_WINDOW
docs: Longest activation window the config may allow; a funded raise that is not activated
within it becomes refundable.

constants.name: MAX_DEMO_KYC_DURATION
docs: The demo KYC key can never grant access for longer than this.

constants.name: MAX_JURISDICTION
docs: Upper bound of ISO 3166-1 numeric country codes; 0 means "not disclosed".

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Bounds on the share mint's token metadata. They keep `create_project` inside one
transaction and bound the compute spent on metadata writes.

constants.name: MAX_RAISE_DURATION
docs: Longest raise a project may run. With the activation window cap it bounds how long an
investor's payment can sit in escrow before it is released or refundable.

constants.name: MAX_RAISE_FEE_BPS
docs: Hard ceiling on the platform fee taken from a successful raise.

constants.name: MAX_RECOVERY_DELAY
docs: Longest recovery delay; it catches a delay given in milliseconds instead of seconds.

constants.name: MAX_REVENUE_FEE_BPS
docs: Hard ceiling on the platform fee taken from every revenue deposit.

constants.name: MIN_RECOVERY_DELAY
docs: Shortest time the affected owner has to veto a share recovery. It rules out a seizure
within one transaction and still fits a devnet demo. Mainnet must configure at least
72 hours and keep the admin role in a Squads multisig (see the program's README).

constants.name: SHARE_DECIMALS
docs: Shares are whole units.
